create_openai_client_together: create an OpenAI client configured with base_url pointing to Together AI and an API key from environment variable
create_chat_completion_together: create a chat completion using the Together AI OpenAI-compatible API with a model alias and user messages
access_completion_message: access the assistant message from the first choice of a chat completion response
configure_openai_base_url: configure the OpenAI client base_url to use a custom API endpoint like Together AI
run_chat_completion_query: run a chat completion query against a Together AI model and print the response message
